sources.quote: The facility consists of two floors and an outdoor spa.
It is home to the world's largest department store, the Shinsegae Centum City.

facts.rationale: A supported vs B contradicted (MT 2010 says floors 1-3). Resolved supported: the Korea Tourism Organization page (T1) says two floors plus an outdoor spa, which outranks the T2 news item; Wikipedia (citing Guinness) and MT confirm world's-largest-department-store record and 2009 opening.

sources.quote: The water in Spa Land’s baths and pools is pumped from two types of hot springs that lie 100 meters underground
Spaland offers services tailored to customer's preferences by using carbonated and saline hot springs drawn from 1,000 meters underground.

facts.rationale: Both supported; numeric resolved true because the fact states a count ('two underground sources'). CNN quote checked on page; VisitKorea confirms carbonated + saline springs.

sources.quote: Noteworthy facilities include Roman Sauna, which is a recreation of an ancient Roman bath; a dry sauna where visitors can experience traditional Finnish-style saunas
Spaland Centum City has the merit of being both a traditional Korean-style public bath and an urban Japanese-style public bath.

facts.rationale: Themed saunas incl. Roman and Finnish, Korean-style bath, many baths documented by VisitKorea.
